tools.name: pushpress_get_company
tools.description: Get the gym (company) this API key belongs to: name, address and contact details. GET /company.

tools.name: pushpress_list_customers
tools.description: List gym customers (members). Filter by email or role. Each customer has id, name, email, phone and membership details. GET /customers.

tools.name: pushpress_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by UUID: name, contact details, address, membership details and assigned staff. GET /customers/{uuid}.

tools.name: pushpress_create_customer
tools.description: Create a new customer (member) with an email address and optional name, phone and date of birth. Writes a new record: check the details first. POST /customers.

tools.name: pushpress_list_classes
tools.description: List scheduled classes, optionally from a start date. Returns class id, title, coach, location and times. GET /classes.

tools.name: pushpress_get_class
tools.description: Get one scheduled class by id. Optional expand adds related records as PushPress defines them. GET /classes/{id}.

tools.name: pushpress_list_class_types
tools.description: List the class types (templates such as Spin or Yoga) the gym offers. GET /classes/types.

tools.name: pushpress_get_class_type
tools.description: Get one class type by id. GET /classes/types/{id}.

tools.name: pushpress_list_reservations
tools.description: List reservations, optionally for one calendar item (a class or event). GET /reservations.

tools.name: pushpress_get_reservation
tools.description: Get one reservation by id. GET /reservations/{id}.

tools.name: pushpress_count_checkins
tools.description: Count check-ins in a date range, optionally for one customer or check-in type. GET /checkins/count.

tools.name: pushpress_list_class_checkins
tools.description: List check-ins for classes in a date range, optionally for one customer. GET /checkins/class.

tools.name: pushpress_get_class_checkin
tools.description: Get one class check-in by UUID. GET /checkins/class/{uuid}.

tools.name: pushpress_list_events
tools.description: List gym events (workshops, camps and other non-class calendar events), optionally from a start date. GET /events.

tools.name: pushpress_get_event
tools.description: Get one event by id. Optional expand adds related records as PushPress defines them. GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: pushpress_list_enrollments
tools.description: List enrollments (a customer's plan or program sign-ups), optionally for one customer or status. GET /enrollments.

tools.name: pushpress_get_enrollment
tools.description: Get one enrollment by UUID. GET /enrollments/{uuid}.

tools.name: pushpress_get_plan
tools.description: Get one membership or pricing plan by id. GET /plans/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pushpress_list_customers, pushpress_create_customer · Private data: pushpress_get_company, pushpress_get_customer, pushpress_create_customer, pushpress_get_class, pushpress_get_event · Public sink: pushpress_list_customers, pushpress_create_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pushpress_list_customers, pushpress_create_customer · Private data: pushpress_get_company, pushpress_get_customer, pushpress_create_customer, pushpress_get_class, pushpress_get_event · Public sink: pushpress_list_customers, pushpress_create_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
